title: Paloma and the Lantern
author: Ulyana Vasquez
blurb: Rosalind Brightwater, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the armistice is signed — or isn't.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
